scope: 24 paired convenience-selected tasks: first two saved accepts and rejects in each of six sources. This is not a representative yield estimate or a complete benchmark. Read-only human-style source review, not a new LLM judge run or production-verifier replay.
conclusions: Native tool calling and genuinely nonthinking generation work in this deployment. Six cases repeat FINAL; five fail harvesting, one runs to the 2048-token cap. Do not silently deduplicate or accept these outputs.

Temperature zero matches the older teacher but differs from Qwen's recommended instruct sampling. Repetition does not establish intrinsic model inferiority. A bounded follow-up with official sampling is a useful next experiment, not a justification for changing production now.
Two TAT-QA answers are correct, including their additional numbers, but normalized exact comparison rejects their explanatory suffixes.

FinQA net purchases answer 7 is correct from expanded seg_7 (15 minus 8). Required seg_8 contains unrelated loan-accounting continuation, so requiring every primary-document chunk creates a false rejection. Current support metadata are document coverage, not minimal evidence annotations.
Free-form normalized-exact diagnostics must not be compared to the baseline's dual semantic judge as an acceptance-rate contest.
Some source questions and labels remain scope-ambiguous. More permissive matching or switching teachers alone will not solve grounding quality. All existing source and release holds remain.
